verdict.line: You lose if you eat Q (Rupture) point-blank and get chunked before you have Grit to answer; you win almost every extended trade once his Q is down, which is why Sett sits at 52.3% over 222 games here.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's entire early lane is Q (Rupture) — a 950-range knockup-slow on a 9s cooldown — poking you from outside your melee range while his autos passively tick Vorpal Spikes (E) if you ever stand in front of him. He has no other ranged tool: W (Feral Scream) is a 300-range cone silence, so once Q is spent he is just a melee champion with no stun and no gap-closer. Every point of poke damage he lands feeds your W (Haymaker) Grit bar, so the more he pokes, the bigger the shield-and-punch you get back the moment he steps in.

theirWindow.when: His Q (Rupture) is up, you're near minions
theirWindow.what: Rupture has a 950 range and pops you into the air with a slow attached — don't stand in minion-wave patterns he can cast through, and don't walk up to trade autos while it's available. If it lands, back off instead of committing further; he gets a free follow-up auto plus Vorpal Spikes (E) damage while you're airborne and slowed.

yourWindow.when: Right after his Q (Rupture) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your window — walk up and force the trade. Open with Q (Knuckle Down) for the empowered next two attacks, then land E (Facebreaker) if he's caught between you and a wall/minion for the stun (if he's only on one side you get a slow instead); if your Grit bar is stacked from the poke he just landed, pop W (Haymaker) mid-trade for the shield plus true/physical damage.

start.why: 52.9% win rate over 221 games, the dominant start (75.7% pick) — the sustain and early damage let you actually punish his melee-range windows instead of just surviving poke.

boots.why: 52.6% win rate over 156 games (57.4% pick) — his only real damage once Q and E spikes land is magic, and the tenacity shortens how long his Q slow and Feral Scream silence lock you down.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (56.6% over 53 games) — the active gives you the gap close to punish his Q cooldown and the AoE slow keeps him from kiting with autos.
Sustained damage and shred to close out the extended trades you're forcing once his poke is spent.
Health plus damage that scales with your missing-health passive (Pit Grit), turning his poke damage directly into your trading power.

you're ahead and want to shorten your Q/E/W cooldowns to punish every window (66.7% win rate over 9 games with this path)

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustained-damage stacking rewards exactly the extended melee trades you're trying to force once his Q is down, and the healing offsets Vorpal Spikes chip damage during those fights.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-picked (83.2%) and best-performing (53.6%) setup — Ignite punishes his Carnivore healing on kills and closes out the solo-kill windows this matchup already favors you in.

playing.title: Hold position against Rupture
playing.detail: Don't stand where a 950-range Q (Rupture) can reach — knockup plus slow is his only way to start damage on you, and he's using it on a 9s cooldown all lane.

playing.title: Trade the instant his Q is spent
playing.detail: The moment Rupture is down he has no stun and no silence that outranges your melee — walk up and open with Q (Knuckle Down) for the bonus max-health damage on your next two hits.

playing.title: Save E for when he's boxed in
playing.detail: Facebreaker (E) stuns only if he's pinned between you and something on the opposite side — against a minion wave or wall. If he's only adjacent on one side, it slows instead, so don't waste it expecting a stun in open space.

playing.title: Dump Haymaker on his all-in, not before
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) banks Grit from every point of poke damage he lands — don't cast it early just to clear the bar. Hold it until he commits to a melee trade so the shield and true-damage center hit land when it matters.

playing.title: Respect his silence range, not his autos
playing.detail: Feral Scream (W) is only 300 range — if you're fighting at your own melee range you're already inside it, so don't disengage just because it's up. Disengage for Rupture, not for Feral Scream.

playing.title: Watch his Feast stacks after level 6
playing.detail: Feast (R) is 175-range true damage that grows him on a kill, up to 6 stacks. If he's eaten several minions or a kill already, expect a bigger health pool and plan your all-ins around his Q (Rupture) cooldown rather than raw stats.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical read, not scraped data.
